cases.case_label: 3-kb retrotransposal insertion in FKTN 3' UTR (Korean patient)
cases.ancestry_or_population: Korean patient carrying the Japanese founder insertion
cases.mechanism_detail: Homozygous ~3-kb retrotransposal (founder) insertion in the 3' non-coding region of FKTN in a Korean boy; parents heterozygous. Element class and mechanism not described in the abstract.
cases.quote: the patient was homozygous for the insertion mutation and his parents were heterozygous carriers of the same mutation.
